source: Source: GrappleFlows community flows read S379 as REFERENCE - facts only (technique names, which leads to which); users own their flows and the site forbids commercial use of its content, so no titles, wording, authors or links are copied

method.flows_using: sum over the 7 sections of the largest count among a move's spellings in that section (84 flows read; a lower bound)
method.aliases: merged spellings are in also_spelled (e.g. Knee Slice / Knee Slide Pass -> Knee Cut Pass, Mata Leao -> Rear Naked Choke, Flower Sweep -> Pendulum Sweep, Achilles Lock / Straight Foot Lock -> Straight Ankle Lock)
method.gi_only: gi only when every section flagged it; overrides: Collar Tie no-gi (WrestleChains collar_tie), Pant Grip and Back Fall Takedown gi (cloth grips)
method.game: have = an id of its own in the game; near = covered by a wider id or a coach cue; lack = nothing
method.grapplemap: checked = searched by hand in assets/grapplemap/GrappleMap.txt (tags and titles); auto = substring/tag hit count, unchecked
method.support: a chain's support = flows of every chain that contains it as a run of steps

top_chains.line: On the back with the hooks in: arm under the chin, squeeze.
Keep the head down, spin off it and climb onto the back.
From mount, an arm that pushes gets stepped over and straightened.
Head under the arm: wrap the neck and choke from the front.
top_chains.game_ref: WrestleChains front_headlock 'lifts her head' -> Guillotine; BeltRoad guillotine

top_chains.line: From side control, come up and drive a knee into the belly for two points.
top_chains.game_ref: BeltRoad POINTS knee_on_belly scores it; no move reaches it

top_chains.line: From side control, slide the knee over the hips and sit in mount.
From the front headlock, thread an arm under the arm and neck and lock the D'Arce.
top_chains.game_ref: BeltRoad darce; no front_headlock -> darce edge

top_chains.line: A triangle that will not finish turns into an armbar on the arm already trapped.
top_chains.game_ref: both moves exist, no link between them

top_chains.line: Pull the arm across, step to the side, take the back.
Lock the hands around the waist from behind, bring them down and stay on the back.
top_chains.game_ref: WrestleChains Slide by ends in a bodylock go-behind; no ground back take from it

top_chains.line: With the legs tied up in the saddle, hide the heel and turn it.
From single leg X, expose the heel and attack it.
top_chains.game_ref: BeltRoad single_leg_x and outside_heel_hook, no link

top_chains.line: Walk around the head into north-south for the choke and the arms.
When the neck is shut on the back, change to an arm.
top_chains.game_ref: armbar exists only from guard and mount

top_chains.line: Lock the legs in a triangle around the waist to keep the back.

plan_shape: A plan row mirrors PlanTemplates.WRESTLING ({id, name, from, idea, arrows}) with the BJJ fields the game already uses: 'moves' are BeltRoad.SYLLABUS ids drilled in order through NoGi f['drill'] = 'move:<id>' (NoGi.drilling_for, one move a week, DRILL_GAIN 3.2), 'chains' are rows like OwnCombos f['book'] ({name, chain}) whose steps are game ids (GroundRules.POSITIONS, BeltRoad.SYLLABUS, WrestleChains.TIES), and 'add' lists ids the game does not have yet.

plans.name: White belt fundamentals
plans.idea: Survive underneath first, then one takedown, one pin and one finish.

plans.name: Closed guard week
plans.idea: From the back: break the posture, then the arm, the neck or the sweep - whichever the top gives.

plans.name: Passing week
plans.idea: Get around the legs or through them, then climb: pass, knee on belly, mount.

plans.name: Back-take week
plans.idea: Every road to the back: the drag, the front headlock and the turtle - then hold it and choke.

plans.name: Leg-lock week
plans.idea: Tie up one leg, then the foot, the heel or the knee - the saddle is home.

plans.name: Competition prep week
plans.idea: Score first (takedown 2, sweep 2, pass 3, knee on belly 2, mount 4), and keep a choke ready on a bad shot.
